mapper.select: SELECT id,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.type')) type,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.reference')) reference,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.sha256')) sha256,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.note')) note,event_time created_at FROM t_system_audit_log WHERE operation='ALERT_DELIVERY_EVIDENCE' AND target_type='ALERT_NOTIFICATION' AND target_id=CAST(#{id} AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs ORDER BY id
